package: K38/R11 — bounded semantic checks for small JSON responses
verified: 200 responses from sidebar, comments and media endpoints are checked for JSON structure and endpoint-specific required fields; invalid JSON, error objects and unplayable media plans fail the semantic predicate.
k6 selectively sets responseType=text for the three small JSON APIs despite global discardResponseBodies=true; homepage HTML and thumbnail bodies remain discarded.
The existing unexpected_content metric and summarizer stop gate reject semantic or MIME contract failures; tests preserve this fail-closed result.
Valid synthetic response shapes pass; malformed JSON, structurally invalid JSON and error-shaped 200 responses fail.
boundaries: No k6 binary/container, HTTP endpoint, application server, database, host load, cleanup, or production resource was used.
The actual k6 runtime did not execute this revision; k6 wiring is covered by source-contract assertions, while response validators and summarizer are executed in tests.
HTML body semantics, thumbnail image decoding, complete JSON schemas, load profiles/mix/versioning and non-production application acceptance remain open.
